title: On Roasting the meat over the open fire
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：roast　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 roast 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the planner ① roasted the meat over the open fire in public, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② roasts the meat over the open fire in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ roast the meat over the open fire at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ roasted the meat over the open fire before — a line in the report for March 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Roasting the meat over the open fire in public, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ roast the beans for a whole afternoon in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Roast the beans for a whole afternoon at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ roasts the beans for a whole afternoon in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ roasted the meat over the open fire again when nobody else would.

⑩ To roast the meat over the open fire, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody roasts the meat over the open fire in silence again and somebody must roast the meat over the open fire in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 烤（一般过去式 roasted the meat over the open fire：1967 年规划员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 烤（一般现在 roasts the meat over the open fire：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 烤（不定式 to roast the meat over the open fire：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 烤（过去完成时 had roasted the meat over the open fire：1961 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 烤（动名词 roasting the meat over the open fire 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 烘焙（roast the beans for a whole afternoon：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去烘焙把豆子烘了整整一个下午）
G. v. 烘焙（roast the beans for a whole afternoon：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 烤（后段两处：新来的市民照例 roasts the beans for a whole afternoon，而母亲又一次 roasted the meat over the open fire）

roast 意为“烤”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面烤在明火上烤那块肉，用一般过去式 roasted 叙述。
roast 意为“烤”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要烤在明火上烤那块肉，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 roast 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the planner roasted the meat over the open fire in public, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner roasts the meat over the open fire in silence whenever the district asks.
Roasting the meat over the open fire in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever roast the beans for a whole afternoon in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district roasts the beans for a whole afternoon in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother roasted the meat over the open fire again, and the district remembered that half.
